title: Planck's quantum of action
summary: To derive the black-body radiation law, Planck assumes resonators exchange energy in elements ε = hν.
landscape: Introduces h. For years it is treated as a formal device about matter, not a property of light.

title: Einstein's light quanta
summary: Einstein proposes that radiation itself behaves as if composed of independent energy quanta, explaining the photoelectric effect.
landscape: The first claim that the quantum belongs to light. Almost universally rejected for nearly two decades.

title: Wave–particle fluctuations
summary: Einstein shows the energy fluctuations of radiation contain both a wave term and a particle term, and predicts a future 'fusion' theory.
landscape: Duality becomes a quantitative problem.

title: First Solvay council
summary: 'The Theory of Radiation and the Quanta', chaired by Lorentz. Curie, Einstein, Planck and Lorentz attend.
landscape: The quantum becomes the central problem of European physics.

title: Bohr's atom
summary: Stationary states and quantum transitions explain the hydrogen spectrum.
landscape: Quantum jumps enter atomic physics.

title: Gravitational waves predicted
summary: Einstein predicts gravitational waves from linearised general relativity; the quadrupole formula follows in 1918.
landscape: A prediction that will wait a century.

title: Einstein's A and B coefficients
summary: Spontaneous and stimulated emission; transition probabilities; the momentum of the light quantum.
landscape: Chance enters quantum theory — through Einstein, who calls it a weakness.

title: Noether's theorem
summary: Every continuous symmetry of the action yields a conservation law.
landscape: A structural principle that will organise twentieth-century physics.

title: The Compton effect
summary: X-rays scattered by electrons shift in wavelength exactly as in a quantum–electron collision.
landscape: Most physicists finally accept that light quanta carry momentum.

title: Bohr–Kramers–Slater proposal
summary: Energy and momentum conserved only statistically; light quanta avoided.
landscape: Bohr's last attempt to avoid light quanta — refuted within a year.

title: De Broglie's matter waves
summary: Every particle is accompanied by a wave, λ = h/p.
landscape: Einstein takes it up; Schrödinger builds on it.

title: Quantum gas; de Broglie noticed
summary: Einstein's paper on the ideal quantum gas draws attention to de Broglie's thesis.
landscape: Matter waves reach Schrödinger's attention.

title: Conservation in single events
summary: Bothe–Geiger coincidences and Compton–Simon cloud-chamber photographs show conservation holds in each event.
landscape: BKS is dead; Bohr accepts it.

title: Exclusion principle
summary: No two electrons in an atom share all quantum numbers.
landscape: Explains the periodic table's structure.

title: Matrix mechanics
summary: Heisenberg reinterprets kinematics using only observable quantities; Born and Jordan recognise matrices.
landscape: The new mechanics begins, without pictures.

title: Electron spin
summary: Uhlenbeck and Goudsmit, Ehrenfest's students, propose an intrinsic angular momentum.
landscape: A new quantum number with no classical picture.

title: Wave mechanics
summary: Schrödinger's equation; quantisation as an eigenvalue problem; equivalence with matrix mechanics.
landscape: Pictures seem to return. The fight over what ψ is begins.

title: Born's probability rule
summary: The wave function determines the probability of outcomes: |ψ|².
landscape: Probability becomes fundamental — or does it?

title: Schrödinger in Copenhagen
summary: Bohr argues with Schrödinger for days about quantum jumps.
landscape: The quarrel over continuity versus discontinuity becomes personal.

title: Transformation theory and quantised radiation
summary: Dirac unifies the formalisms and quantises the electromagnetic field.
landscape: The general structure of the theory becomes visible.

title: The uncertainty relations
summary: Δq·Δp ~ h; the gamma-ray microscope; the path comes into existence when observed; causality fails.
landscape: The limits of classical concepts become exact.

title: Electron diffraction
summary: Davisson and Germer, then Thomson and Reid, diffract electrons.
landscape: Matter waves are an experimental fact.

title: Lemaître's expanding universe
summary: Published in Brussels: a universe of constant mass and increasing radius, with a velocity–distance relation.
landscape: Unnoticed for three years. Einstein learns of it at this council — and dismisses it.
knownNote: Most of the room has not read it. Einstein encounters it here, through Lemaître himself.

title: Einstein's withdrawn manuscript
summary: Einstein seeks definite motions from Schrödinger's waves, then withdraws the paper.
landscape: A private attempt at determinism, abandoned over a problem of separability.
knownNote: Known to very few; it was never published.

title: Double solution and pilot wave
summary: De Broglie's causal interpretation.
landscape: The first worked-out alternative to the statistical view.

title: Ehrenfest's theorem
summary: Quantum averages obey classical equations of motion.
landscape: Classical mechanics reappears inside quantum mechanics.

title: Bohr at Como: complementarity
summary: Bohr presents complementarity at the Volta centenary in Como.
landscape: A framework for the new theory's meaning. Einstein and Schrödinger were not at Como; they meet it here.
knownNote: Heard at Como by Born, Heisenberg, Pauli and others; Einstein meets the argument at this council.

title: Fifth Solvay council: Électrons et Photons
summary: Brussels, 24–29 October 1927. Reports by Bragg, Compton, de Broglie, Born & Heisenberg, and Schrödinger; general discussion chaired by Lorentz.
landscape: You are here.

title: Nobel Prize to Compton and Wilson
summary: Announced weeks after the council.
landscape: Experimental recognition of light quanta and the cloud chamber.

title: The Dirac equation
summary: A relativistic wave equation for the electron; spin emerges; negative-energy solutions appear.
landscape: Relativity and quantum mechanics joined — and antimatter implied.

title: Death of Lorentz
summary: Lorentz dies in Haarlem, 4 February 1928. Einstein speaks at his funeral.
landscape: The chair of the councils is gone.

title: The expanding universe
summary: Hubble's velocity–distance relation; by 1931 Einstein accepts expansion.
landscape: The static universe is abandoned.

title: The photon box
summary: At the sixth council Einstein proposes a box that would violate energy–time uncertainty; Bohr answers with general relativity.
landscape: Einstein shifts from inconsistency to incompleteness.

title: Pauli's neutrino
summary: Pauli proposes a neutral particle to save energy conservation in beta decay.
landscape: Conservation is kept by postulating the unseen.

title: Von Neumann's 'no hidden variables' proof
summary: A rigorous formalism, including a proof taken to exclude hidden variables.
landscape: Widely taken to settle the question — wrongly.

title: The positron
summary: Anderson observes the anti-electron predicted by Dirac.
landscape: Antimatter is real.

title: EPR
summary: Einstein, Podolsky and Rosen argue that quantum mechanics is incomplete.
landscape: Einstein's objection becomes an argument about separated systems.

title: Schrödinger's cat; entanglement named
summary: Schrödinger's cat paper; 'Verschränkung' — entanglement.
landscape: Measurement becomes a paradox about everyday objects.

title: Grete Hermann's critique
summary: Hermann identifies the circular assumption in von Neumann's proof.
landscape: Correct and ignored for three decades.

title: Bohm revives the pilot wave
summary: A consistent deterministic, nonlocal theory reproducing quantum predictions.
landscape: The 'impossible' is shown possible. De Broglie returns to his ideas.

title: Everett's relative states
summary: Quantum mechanics without collapse.
landscape: The measurement problem acquires a radical solution.

title: Mass-generating mechanism proposed
summary: Englert and Brout (Brussels), Higgs, and Guralnik, Hagen and Kibble.
landscape: A way to give gauge bosons mass.

title: Bell's theorem
summary: No local hidden-variable theory can reproduce all quantum predictions.
landscape: Metaphysics becomes experiment.

title: Cosmic microwave background
summary: Penzias and Wilson detect the afterglow of a hot early universe.
landscape: Lemaître's beginning becomes the standard picture.

title: CHSH inequality
summary: A testable form of Bell's inequality: |S| ≤ 2.
landscape: The experiment can be designed.

title: Decoherence
summary: Zeh, later Zurek: interaction with the environment suppresses interference.
landscape: The quantum–classical boundary becomes a dynamical question.

title: First Bell test
summary: Freedman and Clauser observe violation of a Bell inequality.
landscape: Nature sides with quantum mechanics.

title: Black holes radiate
summary: Hawking shows black holes emit thermal radiation.
landscape: Gravity, quantum theory and thermodynamics meet.

title: Delayed choice
summary: Wheeler: decide which-path versus interference after the particle has passed the slits.
landscape: Bohr's 'phenomenon' tested in time.

title: Aspect's experiments
summary: Orsay: Bell violations with settings switched in flight.
landscape: Locality loophole narrowed.

title: Quantum simulation
summary: Feynman proposes computers built of quantum elements.
landscape: Quantum mechanics as a computing resource.

title: Teleportation protocol
summary: Transfer of an unknown quantum state using entanglement plus classical communication.
landscape: EPR correlations as a resource.

title: Shor's algorithm
summary: Efficient quantum factoring.
landscape: Quantum computing becomes consequential.

title: Decoherence observed
summary: Brune, Haroche and colleagues watch a superposition decohere.
landscape: The boundary is measured.

title: Teleportation demonstrated
summary: Innsbruck and Rome teleport photon states.
landscape: Entanglement becomes engineering.

title: Delayed choice realised
summary: Single photons; the configuration chosen randomly after entry into the interferometer.
landscape: Quantum predictions confirmed.

title: Higgs boson discovered
summary: ATLAS and CMS observe a boson at about 125 GeV.
landscape: The Standard Model is complete.

title: Gravitational waves detected
summary: LIGO detects GW150914, a binary black-hole merger.
landscape: Einstein's 1916 prediction confirmed; a new astronomy.

title: Loophole-free Bell tests
summary: Delft, Vienna and NIST close locality and detection loopholes together.
landscape: Local realism is experimentally excluded.

title: Quantum computational advantage claimed
summary: A 53-qubit processor performs a sampling task; the classical difficulty is later debated.
landscape: Quantum machines begin to outrun classical ones on contrived tasks.

title: Nobel Prize for entanglement experiments
summary: Aspect, Clauser and Zeilinger.
landscape: The argument begun at this council is honoured by experiment.
